Given the range of possible values and the second-price mechanism, I'll bid slightly above my true value to increase winning chances while protecting against overpaying. A bid around $10-$11 seems strategically sound.

The worst case with a $40 bid is paying slightly less than $40 if another bidder also bids near my value, which still preserves most of my potential profit.
